name: Baba Is You Vita
author: gl33ntwine
description: Baba Is You is an award-winning puzzle game where you can change the rules by which you play. In every level, the rules themselves are present as blocks you can interact with; by manipulating them, you can change how the level works and cause surprising, unexpected interactions!
requirements:
- kubridge.skprx
- fd_fix.skprx OR repatch_ex.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
